arxiv-2106-00397.title: Strong approximation of Bessel processes Thanks: This work has been supported by the project PERISTOCH ANR–19–CE40–0023, 2020–2024 of the French National Research Agency (ANR)
arxiv-2106-00397.creator: Madalina Deaconu, Samuel Herrmann, [5pt] Université de Lorraine, CNRS, Inria, IECL, F-54000 Nancy, France,Madalina.Deaconu@inria.fr, [5pt] Institut de Mathématiques de Bourgogne (IMB) - UMR 5584, CNRS,Université de Bourgogne Franche-Comté, F-21000 Dijon, FranceSamuel.Herrmann@u-bourgogne.fr
arxiv-2106-00397.description: Abstract We consider the path approximation of Bessel processes and develop a new and efficient algorithm. This study is based on a recent work by the authors, on the path approximation of the Brownian motion, and on the construction of specific own techniques. It is part of the family of the so-called ε \varepsilon -strong approximations.

arxiv-2109-00619.title: Learning compositional programs with arguments and sampling
arxiv-2109-00619.creator: Giovanni De Toni, Luca Erculiani, Andrea Passerini
arxiv-2109-00619.description: Abstract One of the most challenging goals in designing intelligent systems is empowering them with the ability to synthesize programs from data. Namely, given specific requirements in the form of input/output pairs, the goal is to train a machine learning model to discover a program that satisfies those requirements.

arxiv-2211-15899.title: FakeEdge: Alleviate Dataset Shift in Link Prediction
arxiv-2211-15899.creator: Kaiwen Dong, Yijun Tian, Zhichun Guo, Yang Yang, Nitesh V. Chawla
arxiv-2211-15899.description: Abstract Link prediction is a crucial problem in graph-structured data. Due to the recent success of graph neural networks (GNNs), a variety of GNN-based models were proposed to tackle the link prediction task. Specifically, GNNs leverage the message passing paradigm to obtain node representation, which relies on link connectivity.

arxiv-2303-10694.title: Improving Uncertainty Quantification of Deep Classifiers via Neighborhood Conformal Prediction: Novel Algorithm and Theoretical Analysis
arxiv-2303-10694.creator: Subhankar Ghosh, Taha Belkhouja, Yan Yan, Janardhan Rao Doppa
arxiv-2303-10694.description: Abstract Safe deployment of deep neural networks in high-stake real-world applications requires theoretically sound uncertainty quantification. Conformal prediction (CP) is a principled framework for uncertainty quantification of deep models in the form of prediction set for classification tasks with a user-specified coverage (i.e., true class label is contained with high probability).

arxiv-2304-12798.title: Multi-Objective Optimization for 3D Placement and Resource Allocation in OFDMA-based Multi-UAV Networks
arxiv-2304-12798.creator: Asad Mahmood, Thang X. Vu, Shree Krishna Sharma, Symeon Chatzinotas, Björn Ottersten
arxiv-2304-12798.description: Abstract This work considers the orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) technology that enables multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (multi-UAV) communication systems to provide on-demand services. The main aim of this work is to derive the optimal allocation of radio resources, 3 ​ D 3D placement of UAVs, and user association matrices.

arxiv-2411-07616.title: Stochastic resonance in vibrational polariton chemistry
arxiv-2411-07616.creator: Yaling Ke
arxiv-2411-07616.description: Abstract In this work, we systematically investigate the impact of ambient noise intensity on the rate modifications of ground-state chemical reactions in an optical cavity under vibrational strong-coupling conditions. To achieve this, we utilize a numerically exact open quantum system approach–the hierarchical equations of motion in twin space, combined with a flexible tree tensor network state solver.

arxiv-2506-10789.title: Fascist-o-meter : Classifier for Neo-fascist Discourse Online
arxiv-2506-10789.creator: Rudy Alexandro Garrido Veliz, Martin Semmann
arxiv-2506-10789.description: Abstract Neo-fascism is a political and societal ideology that has been having remarkable growth in the last decade in the United States of America (USA), as well as in other Western societies. It poses a grave danger to democracy and the minorities it targets, and it requires active actions against it to avoid escalation.

pmc-10649629.title: Scaling malaria interventions: bottlenecks to malaria elimination
pmc-10649629.creator: Wenhui Mao, Rianna Cooke, Diana Silimperi, Elina Urli Hodges, Ernesto Ortiz, Krishna Udayakumar
pmc-10649629.description: The slow progress in malaria control efforts and increasing challenges have prompted a need to accelerate the research and development (R&D), launch and scaling of effective interventions for malaria elimination. This research, including desk research and key informant interviews, identified the following challenges along the end-to-end scale-up pathway of malaria interventions.

pmc-11286940.title: Seasonal variability in the feeding ecology of an oceanic predator
pmc-11286940.creator: Mitchell S Lovell, Michael J Polito, Josef A Schuster, Emily E Shallow, Alexis M Janosik, Brett J Falterman, Michael A Dance
pmc-11286940.description: Complementary approaches (stomach contents, DNA barcoding, and stable isotopes) were used to examine seasonal shifts in the feeding ecology of an oceanic predator, yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares, n = 577), in the northern Gulf of Mexico. DNA barcoding greatly enhanced dietary resolution and seasonally distinct prey assemblages were observed for both sub-adults and adults.

pmc-11481464.title: Polarization in multidisciplinary perspective
pmc-11481464.creator: Eugen Dimant, Erik O Kimbrough
pmc-11481464.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This article provides an introduction to and overview of the articles in the PNAS Nexus Special Feature on Polarization and Trust.Keywords: polarization, measurement, norms, social media, misinformation

Introduction

Political polarization is a growing concern that disrupts societies worldwide. It is not merely a matter of differing opinions but a phenomenon that deeply influences our psychology, social dynamics, political and economic decision-making, and even the functioning of democratic institutions.

pmc-11646896.title: Primary Cardiac Lymphoma With Dramatic Response to Chemotherapy Diagnosed by Transvenous Biopsy
pmc-11646896.creator: Toshiki Michishita, Osamu Inaba, Moegi Kurachi, Akiko Adachi, Shuji Momose, Yasuaki Hada, Ken Negi, Yutaka Matsumura, Tetsuo Sasano
pmc-11646896.description: Primary cardiac lymphoma is a rare disease with the potential to be fatal. This case reports a patient who developed primary cardiac lymphoma resulting in cardiac tamponade. Despite a compromised general condition, the lymphoma was diagnosed through a transvenous tumor biopsy. Chemotherapy led to significant improvement in the patient’s condition. Malignant lymphoma can be treated with chemotherapy.

pmc-12522698.title: Updating [Nutritional composition dataset of approved infant formula powder in China (2017–2024)] with [Nutritional composition dataset of approved older infant formula powder in China (2017–2024)]
pmc-12522698.creator: Jun Cai, Shuguang Li, Qing Wei, Hong Wang, Yaguang Jiang, Jiao Jiao
pmc-12522698.description: Older infant formula powder, which can meet some of the nutritional needs of infants aged 6 to 12 months, is suitable for normal older infants. In this context, China has established a stringent registration-based regulatory system for infant formula products, requiring mandatory pre-market approval and comprehensive evaluation of all formulations before commercialization.

pmc-13173176.title: 196 Integrating Smartsheet for workforce development: Optimizing digital badging in clinical research coordinator training
pmc-13173176.creator: Yasheca Ebanks, Victoria Appel
pmc-13173176.description: Objectives/Goals: To implement and evaluate a Smartsheet-based system that centralizes management, tracking, and credentialing for the NJ ACTS Clinical Research Coordinator digital badging program, improving efficiency, data integration, and measurable workforce development outcomes. Methods/Study Population: The NJ ACTS CRC digital badging program was integrated into a Smartsheet platform designed to unify data across JotForm, Qualtrics, REDCap, Canvas LMS, and Accredible.

pmc-13253258.title: Vitamin D-related genetic variants as predictive biomarkers for breast cancer in Jordanian women
pmc-13253258.creator: Laith N. Al-Eitan, Maryam K. Alasmar, Mohammed S. Alorjani, Lina M. Sarhan, Sakher S. Sammour, Farah N. Aladwan, Hadil A. Al Refai, Sara S. Hasanat, Mira S. Quran, Mansour A. Alghamdi
pmc-13253258.description: BackgroundVitamin D exerts a protective role in carcinogenesis by regulating signaling pathways implicated in tumor growth and progression. Variants in CYP2R1, CYP24A1, CYP27B1, and DBP have been reported to influence circulating 25(OH)D concentrations and provide evidence for a hypothesis that these polymorphisms may be associated with breast cancer risk by altering vitamin D metabolism and signaling.

pmc-13326507.title: Influence of vapour pressure deficit and CO2 on the thermal sensitivity of stomatal function in tropical trees
pmc-13326507.creator: Alexander W. Cheesman, Peter Cox, Simon Jones, Kali B. Middleby, Lucas A. Cernusak, Peter J. Franks
pmc-13326507.description: Summary Stomatal conductance to water vapour (g s) is typically considered to operate in coordination with photosynthesis (A) to balance carbon gain and water loss in an optimal manner. However, at high temperatures that suppress A, g s has been seen to increase or remain high – reducing the predictive accuracy of some stomatal conductance models.

pmc-13365025.title: Orbital and skull metastases as the initial presentation of lung adenocarcinoma harbouring a MET exon 14 skipping mutation
pmc-13365025.creator: Eiji Ando, Yuri Hayashi, Yasuhiro Matsuo, Hideo Saka
pmc-13365025.description: SummaryA man in his 70s presented with right ocular pain, visual disturbance, forehead swelling and left iliac pain. Diagnostic imaging revealed a large right orbital–frontal mass with skull involvement, a cavitary lesion in the right upper lobe and a left iliac lesion. Histological and molecular analyses confirmed lung adenocarcinoma with a MET exon 14 skipping mutation.

pmc-13468416.title: Development of Arginine Stearate-Based Solid Lipid Nanoparticles for Enhanced Idebenone Delivery: In Vitro Evaluation on Glioblastoma Model

pmc-13474884.title: Adherence to 24-hour movement guidelines and mental health outcomes in Chinese university students
pmc-13474884.creator: Yongtao Yan, Xiangli Zhong, Yang Wang, Sha Liao, Xiangyu Du, Qiyuan He, Yunhan Qing, Cheng Chen, Yisong Yao, Yongyu Huang
pmc-13474884.description: Background Mental health problems such as depression, anxiety, and stress are highly prevalent among university students and may lead to long-term adverse outcomes. Emerging evidence suggests that 24-hour movement behaviors—including physical activity, sedentary behavior, and sleep—play an important role in psychological well-being. However, limited research has examined these behaviors collectively within the 24-hour movement framework among Chinese university students.
